character_design: Pico v2 — redesenhado a partir da solicitação de melhoria do usuário
character_prompt: Mode: built-in image_gen. Use case: illustration-story. Asset: production character sheet for an animated educational pixel-art video, 16:9 landscape canvas, 3 columns by 2 rows of six evenly spaced full-body poses, real transparent alpha background. Reference image is an identity reference ONLY: the cute flying explorer Pico in the car, never reproduce the car, moon, background or lettering. Redesign Pico as a much more polished, expressive professional 32-bit game pixel-art mascot while preserving his gold aviator helmet with small mint wing ornaments, oversized dark-rimmed aqua goggles with clearly visible lively eyes, warm light-brown face, turquoise explorer jumpsuit, coral-red scarf, brown gloves and boots and tiny mint mechanical flight wings/backpack. Give him appealing coherent chibi proportions, sculpted helmet highlights, brass seams, 3-tone cloth folds, distinct expressive eyebrows/eyes, clean dark navy pixel outlines, crisp pixel clusters and tasteful dithering, same character and same scale in all six cells. Top row left: waving hello with cheerful grin; top row middle: pointing left with confident explanation; top row right: curious thoughtful pose hand near chin. Bottom row left: inspecting a small raindrop with a brass magnifying glass; bottom row middle: amazed delighted open smile with hands raised; bottom row right: flying at a gentle diagonal with both wings spread and scarf streaming. All faces point generally toward left/front 3/4 so the character works at right of a video stage. Center each complete pose in its own equal grid cell, generous clear gaps around all silhouettes and props, never cut off tips of wings or boots, no overlapping cells. Genuine detailed handcrafted pixel-art look like a polished indie adventure game, sharply defined individual square pixels, no vector, no smooth 3D, no fuzzy edges, no gradient blur. No text, no labels, no panels, no borders, no ground, no checkerboard baked into background, no watermark. All six silhouettes must be fully isolated on actual transparency. Wide 16:9 only.

backgrounds.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: scenic background for a premium pixel-art science documentary, widescreen 16:9 only. A cozy Brazilian rural garden and covered red-tile porch just before the first rain after a dry spell, dramatic blue-gray storm clouds gathering beyond green hills, warm window glow at right, terracotta pots, basil and fern leaves, cracked ochre soil and little dry pebbles across foreground, a weathered wooden fence, subtle dust, lush layered distant tree silhouettes. Eye-level panoramic composition, deep perspective, richly textured environment, clear open middle area at ground level to animate a character later. Professional hand-crafted 32-bit pixel art like the most beautiful atmospheric indie adventure game, deliberate visible crisp square pixel clusters, selective dithering, nuanced limited palette of navy shadow, moss teal, ochre earth, gold lantern highlights and coral roof. Pixel reflections and material detail, beautiful volumetric-looking lighting represented with stepped pixel bands not smooth gradients. No character, no text, no border, no UI, no diagram, no watermark. Every plant, bark, stone, cloud has considered texture. Avoid flat geometric childish shapes, blur, vector illustration, 3D render, watercolor. Detailed cinematic wide landscape 16:9.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: full widescreen 16:9 scenic background to animate rain over. A magnificent dense green tropical woodland at twilight, footpath leading from foreground toward a little stone bridge and winding stream in middle distance, large moss-covered tree at left, layered ferns, wet leaves, fallen ochre foliage, rain-darkened earth, pools reflecting turquoise and warm gold light, depth between foreground foliage and misty canopy. Show a few resting water drops but do NOT bake rain streaks into the image, rain will be animated separately. Slightly low panoramic camera, atmospheric perspective, interesting foreground edges, usable empty center-right path for an animated explorer character. Exceptionally detailed professional 32-bit pixel art with crisp square clusters, purposeful texture, stepped shading, tasteful dithering, limited rich jewel-tone palette and dark navy outlines where appropriate. Beautiful organic composition, tiny luminous glints on leaves and stream, sophisticated color and light. No people, no mascot, no text, no diagram, no watermark, no borders. Not a vector, not a smooth painting, not 3D. Sharp individual pixel clusters, genuinely polished indie game environment. Wide 16:9.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: fantastical illustrative underground scenic backdrop for an educational pixel-art sequence, wide 16:9. A macro-scale journey inside a richly textured damp forest soil world: a cross-section-like underground cavern of warm brown earth grains, tiny quartz flecks, complex cream and amber roots branching overhead, moss and leaf litter at top edge, dark porous cavities, subtle turquoise pools in small crevices, tiny muted amber glints. NO bacteria or animals or molecular symbols, no labeled scientific structures; this is an imaginative scenic atmosphere only, precise diagrams will be composited separately in code. Panoramic side-on view with depth and strong contrasting left vs right organic forms, dark open center foreground space for educational graphics and explorer. Professional high-detail hand-crafted 32-bit pixel art, crisp visible square clusters, nuanced selective dithering, sophisticated warm ochre and dark navy shadow palette accented moss teal and pale gold, tactile layered material textures. Avoid simplistic rectangles, chunky childish flat art, blurred gradients, vector art, 3D render. No character, no text, no watermark, no borders. Strict widescreen 16:9 landscape.

notes: Cenários são ilustrações artísticas. Ciência, partículas, bactérias e colêmbolos são esquemas sem escala criados em código. Movimento de chuva, névoa, câmera, reflexos, folhas e Pico é acrescentado na montagem.
